reading_note: The teaching unfolds the five successive stages by which divine truth (Light) is liberated from the dominion of self-love (Darkness). Each "salvation" is a discrete degree of redemption: (1) the First Man — divine truth's initial descent into the realm of self-love, where some good is preserved within the very forces that swallowed it; (2) the Living Spirit — the operative power that, with the matrix of life, establishes the ordered cosmoses (degrees of the natural mind) so that swallowed light can be raised; (3) the Third Ambassador — the awakening call which reveals the image of light before the firmaments, drawing forth what remained captive; (4) Jesus the Splendour — divine truth descending all the way to the flesh, establishing the Call and the Hearing within the elements, forming the inner Jesus-the-Youth and ascending again to the celestial; (5) the Great Counsel / Column of Glory — the consummated ascent of all souls back to the Light forever. The single arc: divine truth's progressive descent into the lowest, and its progressive rescue of every degree of good from self-love, until what fell returns wholly to its source.
